name: Dumbbell Reverse Fly
focus: Upper back and back of the shoulders
description: Bent forward from the hips with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging, open your arms out to the sides to shoulder height, squeezing your shoulder blades, then lower.

source.title: Muscle & Strength: Bent Over Dumbbell Reverse Fly
source.note: Described in our own words. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Hinge forward with a flat back, knees soft.
A dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging.
cues: Lead with your elbows, a soft bend in them.

prescription.note: Pick a weight you can lift for every rep with good form. Move slowly: about 2 seconds to lift or push and 2 seconds to lower, resting between exercises as needed.

keyframes.name: Row
keyframes.cue: Pull the weights up toward your hips.
